name: Kozukuri Chintai ~Reikin Shikikin Nashi, Haramase Ari~
original_name: 子作り賃貸 ～礼金敷金なし、孕ませあり～
source:
After accepted by an university in Tokyo, the protagonist finds it difficult to find a room to live.
After searching for the various kind of rooms, he finds a room where the rent is free!

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE052202.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
被东京的一所大学录取后，主角发现很难找到住的房间。
各种房间都找遍了，终于找到了免租的房间！

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE052202.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
